purpose: Describe an action as recently completed from the speaker’s perspective.
keywords: I have only recently come to Japan.
I have just eaten lunch, so I am not hungry.
These are shoes I only bought last month.
Locate a just-finished action or describe subjective recency
たばかり · still recent to the speaker
restrictions: The elapsed time can be longer than a literal moment if it feels recent in context.
mistake: Do not impose the immediate-instant meaning of たところ on every たばかり.

segments.role: Describe an action as recently completed from the speaker’s perspective. た-form + ばかり.
